images.caption: The Butterworth Building, 1921 First Avenue, Seattle, Washington, is on the National Register of Historic Places, ID #71000873. Originally a mortuary (the Halloween Listings in Seattle alternative weekly The Stranger say it was Seattle's first, but I suspect it is merely the oldest surviving). There have been many claims that the building is haunted.

images.filename: Pike Place Market - former foundations west of Western Avenue.jpg
images.caption: Foundations of Municipal Market Building (architect unknown, 1922 or 1924; demolished after a 1974 fire) west of Western Avenue, Pike Place Market Historical District, Seattle, Washington. The structure now known as the Desimone Bridge once connected the Municipal Market Building to the Market's North Arcade.
images.alt: Foundations of Municipal Market Building (architect unknown, 1922 or 1924; demolished after a 1974 fire) west of Western Avenue, Pike Place Market Historical District, Seattle, Washington. The structure now known as the Desimone Bridge once connected the Municipal Market Building to the Market's North Arcade.
